tagline.chat: Your general assistant. It searches, reads your files, runs code and makes media.
tagline.documents: Writes a document from your brief, checked against the sources you give it.
tagline.research: Researches a question on the web and writes a dossier where every finding cites a source.
tagline.finance: Briefs, ratios, budgets and cash flow. The figures are computed, never guessed.
tagline.data: Reads a table you add and answers questions about it with real queries.
tagline.market: A market briefing from live prices and news, with every number computed by the app.
tagline.legal: Reviews contracts for a matter: memo, redlines and a check on every citation.
tagline.meeting: Turns a recording or a transcript into minutes, decisions and actions.
tagline.images: Makes pictures from a description, or changes a picture you add.
tagline.videos: Makes a short video clip from a description or a first frame.
tagline.music: Makes a song or an instrumental from a description or your lyrics.
tagline.edit: Cuts and arranges your video and audio on a timeline.
tagline.presentations: Builds a slide deck from a brief and checks every slide fits.
tagline.education: Lesson plans, quizzes and study guides for a topic or a file.

home.studioTitle: The {name} studio runs its own checks
home.studioNote: This chat does the work with the general tools. The {name} harness, with its own checks, is not connected to the chat yet: open the studio when you need that run.
home.everything: Ask me anything. I can also write, research, work with your files, and make pictures, clips and decks.

dossier.label: Research dossier
dossier.notSaved: The dossier was written but could not be saved, so it cannot be opened here.

page.title: Virtual agents
page.lede: Every agent is a harness: a prompt, tools, limits and checks that the app enforces on each run. Hire the ones your work needs.
page.noneAvailable: Every agent is already on your desk.

made.deleteBody: All chats with {name} are deleted, with their messages, tool records and any cards they left in the Knowledge Base. Files and uploads stay. {name} is taken out of any Workspace it was brought into; the Workspace keeps everything else it holds.
made.stubNote: No model is connected, so this draft is your own words. Edit it, then create the agent.

error.invalidPrompt: Describe the agent in 2,000 characters or fewer.
error.draft: Could not draft the agent. Try again.
error.draftInvalid: The draft came back in a form the app could not read. Try again with a clearer description.
error.invalidAgent: Check the name, description and instructions, then try again.
error.forbidden: You cannot do that on this desk.
error.notFound: This agent is no longer on your desk.
error.notDeletable: This agent is built in and cannot be deleted.
error.inUse: Someone else has a chat with this agent, so it cannot be deleted yet.

new.lede: Describe the agent in one prompt. Check the draft, change anything you like, then create it.
